work.name: The Cigna Group
work.summary: Mostly Devops with some data engineering.

projects.name: Self Hosted Action Runners
projects.summary: Developed an alternative to GitHub-hosted runners in AWS, creating a scalable ecosystem of on-demand VMs using EC2 Fleet, API Gateway, and Lambda, supported by a tagging strategy.

projects.name: Custom Terraform Provider
projects.summary: Managed the Enterprise Databricks platform through a buggy API that lacked adherence to RESTful principles. To resolve issues with permissions and resource management, we created a Terraform provider that wrapped the API, enabling effective state management. This evolved into a Python package and GitHub Action to process team definitions from a JSON file.

projects.name: Terraform CDK Conversion
projects.summary: Migrated Terraform module definitions to Python to address limitations in logic. This migration allowed selective deployment of expensive Databricks jobs, reducing costs and streamlining CI pipelines. Leveraging Terraform's CDK for Python enabled the creation of abstract base models with smart defaults and simplified configuration using type hints.

projects.name: Python CICD Library
projects.summary: Converted Jenkinsfile and Groovy scripts to pure Python to create a more testable script runner.

projects.name: GitHub Action Automation
projects.summary: Created reusable organizational GitHub Actions and workflows to improve efficiency.
highlights: ServiceNow API for managing release tickets
AI-driven PR descriptions using a RAG template

projects.name: PySpark File Ingestion
projects.summary: Developed a PySpark ETL job in Databricks to process files transferred from NAS to S3, organizing disordered file paths and inconsistent naming conventions while aggregating contents.

projects.name: Microservice Development and DevOps
projects.summary: Developed a Flask API and managed CI/CD pipelines for efficient deployment.
